subsystem: API19 java.lang.String(byte[]) in the host DEX runtime
observed_discontinuity: The unchanged APK's LevelManager constructor invokes String(byte[]) after reading its asset, but the host DEX String class has no constructor; its lenient framework lookup can fall through to Object.<init>, leaving the String receiver without text.
required_semantics: String(byte[]) decodes bytes using Android's default UTF-8 charset into the allocated String receiver
The resulting receiver is a distinct Java String object, not an interned replacement

differences.description: The host DEX String class had no byte-array constructor, so the original LevelManager's text decoding did not mutate its new String receiver.
differences.relevance: LevelManager parses the level list from this receiver before FrozenGame initializes bubble counts.

earliest_evidenced_divergence: The exact original DEX method table contains String.<init>([B)V and LevelManager invokes it, while the prior host String class registered no constructor.

evidence.artifact: Original APK classes.dex method id 91 is java.lang.String.<init>([B)V; current VM registration lacks that method and LevelManager's constructor consumes its result.

remaining_uncertainty: The VM currently stores UTF-8 as C strings; embedded NUL, malformed UTF-8 replacement, and non-ASCII UTF-16 indexing remain outside this focused ASCII level-text contract.
